build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module to encode atom distances using Gaussian basis functions with configurable start, stop, and width
create_sigmoid_smearing: create a SigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid basis functions with configurable parameters
build_linear_sigmoid_smearing: build a LinearSigmoidSmearing module that combines sigmoid activation with a linear residual term for distance encoding
create_silu_smearing: create a SiLUSmearing module that uses a linear layer and SiLU activation to encode atom distances
test_smearing_forward: test the forward pass of any smearing class by passing a distance tensor and verifying output shape
